name: Settlement-average taker, BTC+DOGE
description: settle-avg's rule unchanged (last 45 s, partial-average model from Binance 1 s, buy the 60-98c favourite when model beats ask+fee by 3c) on the two coins the original full test left out for runtime only: BTC and DOGE.
hypothesis: Same mechanism as settle-avg: late quoters don't know how much of the 60 s settlement average is already fixed. Dev screen on trade prints (net of fee): BTC +1.9c, DOGE +1.7c, smaller than ETH +4.1c / SOL +3.2c, so BTC (efficient, deep) may be near zero. Fixed in advance, no tuning on these coins. Wrong if pooled full CI includes 0, months flip, or 2x latency kills it.
next: smoke -> quick -> full 1/3 (BTC+DOGE pooled), lockbox only if promising.
